description: This file defines the CassandraGatewayListProvider class, which implements the IGatewayListProvider interface for managing gateway lists in an Orleans clustering environment using Cassandra as the backend. It includes methods for initialization and retrieving gateway URIs, with caching and configuration options.

classes.name: CassandraGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Implements IGatewayListProvider to provide gateway list management for Orleans clusters using Cassandra, with caching and configuration support.

methods.name: CassandraGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the provider with configuration options and service provider.

methods.name: MaxStaleness
methods.description: Property returning the maximum staleness duration for cached gateway list.

methods.name: IsUpdatable
methods.description: Property indicating that the gateway list provider supports updates.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Asynchronous method to initialize the session and queries, ensuring the necessary table exists.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Asynchronous method to retrieve the list of gateway URIs, utilizing caching.
